name: Kazuki Accounting Export for WooCommerce
author: kazukiyamashita80

sections.description:
Exports WooCommerce orders to Yayoi journal import format. Default: 25 columns and Shift-JIS .txt for Yayoi Blue Return (やよいの青色申告). Select 27 columns for Yayoi Accounting desktop.

  • 8% and 10% consumption tax buckets per order

  • Compound journal flags (2000 / 2110 / 2100 / 2101)

  • Qualified invoice registration number in journal memo (works with Kazuki Qualified Invoice Number for WooCommerce)

  • Mark orders as exported to avoid duplicate booking

  • Shift-JIS, UTF-8, or UTF-8 BOM export

Target: Yayoi Blue Return and Yayoi Accounting desktop (仕訳日記帳 → ファイル → インポート). Online products are not verified.

Disclaimer: This plugin does not provide tax or accounting advice. Verify exported journals with your accountant before importing into Yayoi. Journal description (摘要) is limited to 30 characters on Yayoi desktop.

WooCommerce tax calculation must be enabled with 8% and 10% rates configured for mixed-rate orders.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.

  2. Activate through the Plugins menu.

  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active.

  4. Configure under WooCommerce → Settings → 会計エクスポート.

  5. Export under WooCommerce → 会計エクスポート.
sections.faq:
Does this support freee or Money Forward?

Not in the free version. Planned as Pro formats.

What about mixed 8% and 10% orders?

The plugin generates compound journal rows with correct identification flags.

Which Yayoi product is supported?

Yayoi Blue Return (25 columns) and Yayoi Accounting desktop (27 columns). Yayoi Accounting Next / online are not verified.

1.0.6

  • WordPress.org review prep: Kazuki display name, Requires Plugins header, remove load_plugin_textdomain.

1.0.5

  • 複合仕訳2行目以降の取引日付・タイプをやよい仕様に合わせて空欄に変更。

1.0.4

  • やよいの青色申告: 識別フラグ 2110 等の伝票データにタイプ 3（振替伝票）を設定。

1.0.3

  • やよいインポート向けに引用符なしCSV・CRLF改行に変更。

  • 税区分デフォルトを税込記述形式（課税売上込10% / 課税売上込軽減8%）に修正。

  • 税込モードでは税金額列を空欄にし、付箋2を 0 に固定。

1.0.2

  • やよいの青色申告向け 25 列フォーマット（デフォルト）。

  • 借方税区分「対象外」・借方金額 0 を複合仕訳の空借方行に設定。

  • 列形式設定（25列 / 27列）と借方税区分設定を追加。

1.0.1

  • Shift-JIS .txt export for Yayoi Blue Return / desktop Yayoi products.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: Yayoi journal CSV export.
